## Outcome

Describe the user-visible problem solved by this change.

## Behavior and safety

- Which commands, targets, processes, files, or output contracts change?
- Are all mutations explicitly target-scoped and independently verified?
- Could this expose identifiers, credentials, logs, or local paths?

## Verification

- [ ] `bun run verify` passes.
- [ ] New or changed branches have focused tests.
- [ ] Public behavior and documentation agree.
- [ ] Interactive and non-interactive behavior were both considered.
- [ ] Real-device evidence is included when the claim depends on hardware.
- [ ] No private project data, device identity, or secret was committed.

## Evidence

List deterministic fixtures, host/runtime coverage, and any real-device checks.
